text:
Taylor (AE): Quick heads-up — Neptune Labs sent a CAIQ + custom PCI appendix. POC kickoff Tue 10am PST, they want answers before the demo. Who can own triage?
Amanda R: I can pick this up today and do an initial mapping to our template. tagging @Raj P for security review.
Raj P: Thanks @Amanda R. Can you drop the doc link here? Need to know whether it's full CAIQ or a stripped set.
Taylor (AE): Link: https://neptune.example.com/forms/caix-2026 (password in lastpass). It's full CAIQ + 2 custom PCI Qs about HSM and BYOK.
Amanda R: Got it. Initial plan: 1) map CAIQ answers we already have, 2) flag bespoke PCI Qs for security owner, 3) estimate ETA. I'll post a diff doc.
Raj P: Sounds good. For HSM/BYOK we likely need eng confirmation on KMS/HSM support and any caveats. @Linh T can you confirm on Dedicated/Private options?
Linh T: Linh T: We support customer-managed keys via KMS in Private; Dedicated requires a ticket for BYOK. HSM-specific certs depend on infra provider. I can draft a short note.
Amanda R: ETA for initial pass: EOD today. Will add a small table with where we can reuse existing CAIQ answers vs new notes.
Taylor (AE): Perfect. Also client asked about expected turnaround for the full answered questionnaire — they're sensitive to timelines. Can we commit to 48-72h after triage?
Raj P: 48-72h seems reasonable if triage completes today and no deep infra changes. If HSM vendor certs required, add more runway.
Amanda R: I'll flag any blockers in the diff doc and mark items "security-required". If anyone wants to reassign, say now.
Security Bot: Incidentality check: no active incidents. Adding ticket #SEC-4392 to track this intake.
Taylor (AE): Thanks all. I'll update the customer: triage today, answers in ~48-72h pending HSM docs.
Amanda R: Uploaded initial mapping: https://drive.redwood/incoming/neptune-caix-diff.md — short list at top, comments inline.
Raj P: Reviewing now. If I don't finish by 5pm I'll leave inline notes for next steps.
Linh T: Adding a short snippet for BYOK flow: ```1) Customer provides key via KMS 2) We validate ARNs and IAM setup 3) Rotate keys per contract``` Will paste into doc.
Amanda R: Nice. Marking owners in doc: Security = @Raj P, Solutions = @Linh T, AE = @Taylor (AE).
Taylor (AE): One more ask from procurement: will this require an addendum to the contract? If so, what level?
Raj P: Likely a narrow security addendum for BYOK/HSM language — I can draft suggested language after the review.
Amanda R: Closing loop: I'll ping again at 5pm with final triage status. :thumbsup:
Taylor (AE): Great, thanks team.
